command: set -euo pipefail; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; PROPERTIES="$HOME/.shelly-link/android/alpha-signing.properties"; test -f "$APK"; test -f "$PROPERTIES"; read_property(){ sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$PROPERTIES" | head -1; }; STORE_FILE="$(read_property storeFile)"; STORE_PASSWORD="$(read_property storePassword)"; KEY_ALIAS="$(read_property keyAlias)"; APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name apksigner | sort | tail -1)"; KEY_FP="$(keytool -list -v -keystore "$STORE_FILE" -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" 2>/dev/null | awk '/SHA256:/{print $2; exit}' | tr -d ':' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; APK_FP="$("$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" | sed -n 's/^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; test -n "$KEY_FP"; test "$KEY_FP" = "$APK_FP"; echo "Alpha signer SHA-256: $APK_FP"; shasum -a 256 "$APK"; ls -lh "$APK"
